question: Can reward-modulated numerical structural plasticity write NAND connectivity from observations without a symbolic expression compiler selecting the graph?
hypothesis: A bounded numerical trial/commit circuit will fit at least 95% of public labels across all 32 five-label signatures and four noise seeds, exceed disabled-plasticity and random-update public accuracy by at least 10 percentage points, and cold-restore exactly. Failure is a scientific negative, not a reason to change the frozen budget.

mechanism.substrate: 3 raw bits, 6 feedforward NAND threshold sites; each of 12 incoming connections and the output is a one-hot numeric synaptic vector. Initially all connections zero and output connected to input0. Task-specific mutation locations and replacement source vectors arrive as evidence-independent noise. A threshold mismatch population accumulates observed error; a numeric threshold reward neuron admits strict improvements. Masked synaptic updates commit or revert the proposed wiring. No symbolic program, truth-mask candidate catalog, task-conditioned Python min/sort/argmin or compiled graph is supplied to the candidate.
mechanism.honesty: This is a deliberately hand-designed numerical implementation of stochastic structural search with a scalar reward comparator, not invention of a new primitive or a proof that search has ceased. The question is whether the decisions are actually realized by numerical synaptic state/threshold transitions. If the code selects a task-specific graph externally, the experiment is INVALID. No claim that writing the search policy in numerical form makes it intrinsically superior or autonomous.
mechanism.external: Python implements generic bounded simulation, independent pseudorandom proposal inputs, input validation, counters, checkpoint IO and diagnostics. It must not condition mutation proposals on target masks/hidden labels or select an improved graph using a Python conditional. Gates and reward comparator are predesigned.

frozen_design.worlds: all 256 3-input Boolean masks; learning executed once for each of 32 unique signatures at public indices [0,1,2,4,7] and seeds [17,29,43,71], then evaluated for every compatible world; no task labels beyond the five examples enter the learner
frozen_design.ordering: observations fixed above; signature enumeration binary ascending; seeds fixed order
frozen_design.data_budget: five outcomes per task, no extra interventions
frozen_design.compute_budget: 1024 proposed single-row rewires per signature/seed; six gates on each of five public contexts per trial; all methods receive equal observations, measured operations/times, no false compute parity
frozen_design.capacity: six NAND sites, 12 one-hot incoming rows of lengths 3..8 and one length9 output row: 75 binary synaptic scalars plus 1 output selector row of9 = 75 total (actual count verified in report); scalar loss/reward activity and evidence buffers counted separately; no task-ID input
frozen_design.stop: Always exactly1024 trials; no extra trials after poor fit; 30 minute hosted job timeout, no protected first use

controls.exact_symbolic: Frozen WSP14 synthesize, same five examples, independent expression runtime; perfect public fit expected; full search and cache setup counted separately
controls.trained: Frozen WSP14 fully trained eight-hot Adam BCE<=.02 within2048 steps, same observations, convergence checked; a converged memorizer is not a strongest structural neural baseline
controls.precompiled: Frozen WSP14 NumericNand compilation from exact symbolic program, same evidence; an externally constructed reference, not proof of internal construction
controls.random_update: Same proposals and budget; force commit reward1 regardless of error
controls.disabled: Same proposals, losses and budget, force commit reward0
controls.unidentifiable: For all256 worlds each deterministic evidence-only method must produce exactly384/768 correct per seed on uniform hidden labels; identical evidence with all hidden flipped must not change learned synapses
controls.reward_lesion: Replacing numerical reward feedback with0 must match disabled circuit bit for bit

classification_rules.engineering: Implementation checks, strict custody/malformed input/feedback controls and reproducibility pass; engineering does not require the hypothesis to succeed
classification_rules.mechanism_supported_dev: public fit>=608/640 and >=64/640 extra correct over each random/disabled control; 128/128 cold snapshots and deterministic replay; this is development support only
classification_rules.negative: Any frozen mechanism threshold missed, with valid controls
classification_rules.scientific_pass: Not available from this authored public DEV experiment; requires strongest matched baseline and independent qualification; preserve exact symbolic tie or deficit
classification_rules.invalid: Task-specific external selection, hidden label leakage, changed budget/threshold, invalid comparator/custody or broken deterministic simulation

qualification: Pin final SHA/tree, full original + WSP01-15 unit regressions, all predecessor DEV evaluators and new frozen DEV evaluator, permanent G29 atlas, clean source, read-only PR GitHub-hosted Ubuntu and Windows2022 at the same exact source. No self-hosted jobs.
preregistration_note: Commit before implementation and primary outcomes. Capacity arithmetic typo, if any, must be disclosed before first evaluation; intended row lengths specify architecture exactly.
